literal: perfect tense of kustaafu, to retire; 1st person carries no gender
mwalimu is the same word for a male or female teacher
muuguzi is the same word for a male or female nurse
contracted na-, matching this pack's own Natoka/Nasafiri
nina = I have, matching transit-rides.i-am-in-a-hurry's Nina haraka
mama/baba take yangu rather than the regular class-1 wangu
kaka/dada, like mama/baba, take yangu not wangu
mpenzi is the ordinary word for a romantic partner of any gender, not a business partner (mshirika)
